breadth.review_scope: Structural review of every changed function group, preservation of all full changed records and explicit remaining limits. Not whole-corpus native equivalence.

first_capture_review.scope: Review of all 155 language/name groups across the first complete 439-change capture. Normalized views coalesce temporary identifiers and duplicate lines; original per-function diffs remain authoritative. This is structural review, not whole-runtime native equivalence.

conclusions.imported_callees: Explicit exact two full-width integer results become fields at offsets0,8; argument names/types follow the checked DWARF contract. Ordinary aggregate/mixed/narrow/more-than-two-result imports remain excluded.
conclusions.callers: Paired calls use one invocation with RAX/RBX projections; downstream high-variable typing changes names, casts, pointer views and some loop shapes. Cross-function inference outside imported contracts remains incomplete.
conclusions.sysGrow_closure: The former void closure now returns a pair, matching the source addrRangeToSummaryRange closure (runtime/mpagealloc_64bit.go).
conclusions.c: Ordinary struct shape/projections have native proof using explicit-width ctypes/realtypes off; broad default C output still includes identifier/type-spelling/runtime dependency gaps.
conclusions.rust: Ordinary pair shape/projections reviewed, but no claim that the changed Go runtime bodies compile as Rust. Byte-array pseudo-members, casts to aggregates, signedness and wrapping literals remain open.
conclusions.opaque_calls: First capture retains invalid raw-to-struct casts in mheap.allocSpan; round2 extends the guarded adapter to unresolved unlocked return prototypes. Fresh full capture and native binding required.
